observed_mechanism.inference_receipt_v3: make_inference_receipt does not invoke a model. It accepts model_call_id, output_ref, output_sha256 and output_size from its caller after validating Entry/route/engine admission and verified engine-load evidence.
observed_mechanism.current_binder_v2: The latest retained donor correctly treats model_call_id as opaque correlation metadata and derives the admissible logical cell only from the exact GRID10 plan plus the single-lane/single-model-cell fence.
observed_mechanism.current_test_contract: Cross-cell- or cross-plan-shaped model_call_id values are retained only as opaque metadata and cannot move the independently bound GRID10 plan/cell fields.
observed_mechanism.critical_residual: Exact GRID10 plan identity plus a single admitted model lane identifies the only eligible logical model cell, but does not independently prove that the caller-supplied output bytes were actually produced by that cell or by any real model invocation.

adjudication.reason: A caller-controlled label cannot be independent evidence that a real model execution produced the referenced bytes. Syntactic agreement with grid10:<plan>:<cell>:<role> can be self-certified by the same caller.
adjudication.safe_claim_now: The v3 path can establish candidate bookkeeping consistency around one eligible logical model cell. It cannot establish real output-producing-cell provenance or model runtime credit.

required_architecture_delta.proposed_evidence_contract: HCU_MODEL_EXECUTION_RECEIPT/v1 or equivalent in-place verified execution object
required_architecture_delta.producer_boundary: MUST be minted by the admitted real model executor/loader boundary from bytes actually consumed and emitted, not reconstructed from caller labels downstream
required_architecture_delta.downstream_rule: InferenceReceipt must consume verified execution evidence for output fields rather than accepting those fields as independent caller assertions before any real model/runtime credit is possible.
required_architecture_delta.binder_rule: J-Space binding should bind to the verified execution evidence and exact GRID10 identity; model_call_id remains correlation metadata unless the executor itself cryptographically/causally mints it inside that evidence.
required_architecture_delta.authority_law: This evidence object is not a second truth/effect/state authority; it is bounded causal evidence feeding the existing candidate-only inference receipt path.

must_reject: caller swaps output_sha256 while retaining execution receipt identity
caller swaps output-producing cell or role
execution receipt is rebound to another GRID10 plan or generation
execution receipt references a different verified engine-load consumption receipt
replayed invocation id carries different output bytes
multi-lane execution lacks an executor-minted exact output-producing cell identity
falsifiers_and_acceptance.positive_gate: One FREE_ONLY exact-source isolated run in which the admitted real model executor mints the execution evidence from actual model input/output bytes, then the canonical inference receipt and J-Space binder consume it without caller-supplied output provenance.

next_exact_gate: Fuse the independent model-execution/output evidence contract into the single retained PR1263 inference path without creating a second inference authority; add deterministic provenance/replay/rebind regressions; rebind the single PR810 fixed executor to those exact current bytes; then execute one authorized FREE_ONLY exact-source real local-model path. Until then, keep HCU model/J-Space/training/whole-product runtime credit at zero.
